rules.headings: Montserrat ExtraBold (800) or Black (900), ALWAYS UPPERCASE. Tracking tight (tracking-tighter).
rules.body: Montserrat Regular (400) or Medium (500). Tracking normal.
rules.accents: Uppercase, highly tracked (e.g., tracking-widest) for overlines, labels, and manifesto numbers.

colors.rules: No neon, no glows, no bright gradients. Matte, flat, high contrast. Use #C2185B (Matte Rose) exclusively for CTAs (WhatsApp, Quero este resultado) and specific highlighted words. Use #800020 (Deep Burgundy) for subtle borders or large geometric background accents. Text must use pure white (#FFFFFF) for headings and ivory/nude (#E8DFD8) for descriptions.

visual_enhancers.shadows: None. Rely on 1px solid borders (#2A2A2A) to separate elements. No soft box-shadows. Keep it flat, brutalist, and technical.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Sharp edges (rounded-none) or extremely minimal (rounded-sm/2px). Do not use fully rounded pill buttons. Sharpness implies precision and aggressive elegance.
visual_enhancers.textures: Include a subtle noise overlay across the main background (opacity 2-4%) to simulate matte editorial paper, removing any 'digital screen' feel.

components.name: Hero Section
components.instructions: Full height (min-h-screen). Asymmetrical layout. High-quality professional image with subtle scroll parallax. Kinetic typography for the main headline with masked line-by-line reveal on load (using framer-motion). Include authority metrics (+1.200 atendimentos, 100% precisão, avaliação 5.0) arranged in a structured, technical grid (1px visible borders). Prominent WhatsApp CTA button in Matte Rose.

components.name: Editorial Marquee
components.instructions: A slow, infinite scrolling marquee dividing sections. Use text like 'BEAUTY ACADEMY • NAILS DESIGNER • LASH LIFTING • BROW LAMINATION •'. Font must be Montserrat 800, uppercase. Style it as transparent text with 1px white stroke, or solid #1A1818 text on a #800020 background.

components.name: Rotating Card
components.instructions: An eye-catching, animated decorative element placed strategically in the middle of the flow. Contains the text 'Olá, Maravilhosas! ❤️'. It should slowly rotate 360 degrees infinitely (via framer-motion), acting as a visual anchor. Use matte surface #1A1818 with sharp edges.

components.name: Specialties Grid
components.instructions: 4 manifesto-style numbered cards (01, 02, 03, 04). Services: Nails Designer, Design de Sobrancelhas, Brow Lamination, Lash Lifting. Hover state: image scales up subtly inside a hidden overflow container, text colors may invert or highlight in pink. No prices allowed.

components.name: Portfolio Gallery
components.instructions: Asymmetrical, bento-style grid. Each portfolio item must include a sharp, discreet CTA button: 'Quero este resultado'. Intersecting the gallery, display the phrase: 'A combinação perfeita entre você, a sua beleza e o seu momento.' in large, imposing typography.

components.name: Location & Footer
components.instructions: Dark, minimalist map/location section. Button 'Como chegar' in Matte Rose. Final bold scheduling call-to-action. Footer should be extremely minimal: copyright, WhatsApp link, technical text.

grids_and_layouts.strategy: Swiss Brutalist mixed with High-End Fashion Editorial (Fenty Beauty / NARS style). Use sharp grid lines and visible borders (1px solid #2A2A2A) to compartmentalize information. Asymmetry creates visual tension and interest.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-12 to p-24 (Tailwind) for section padding. Do not cramp elements. Let the negative space emphasize luxury.

motion_and_interactions.scrolling: MUST use 'lenis' library for smooth momentum scrolling. This is critical for the premium luxury feel.
motion_and_interactions.reveal: Use framer-motion for scroll-triggered text reveals and image fade-ins. Keep animations slow and deliberate (e.g., duration 0.8s, ease out).
motion_and_interactions.hover: Buttons should have a sharp background color fill transition. Images should have a slow, elegant scale effect on hover without bouncing.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure pure white text on #0F0E0E and #1A1818 meets APCA standards.
accessibility.animations: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query for all framer-motion animations.

libraries_and_tools.3d_libraries: Framer Motion for 2D parallax and kinetic components. Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. lucide-react for sharp minimal icons.
libraries_and_tools.commands: yarn add framer-motion @studio-freight/lenis lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure complete adherence to the 'Montserrat only' typography rule. Import it via Google Fonts. Do not use Inter or any other sans font.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling immediately at the App.js / index.js root level.
Use framer-motion heavily for the masked hero text reveal and the rotating 'Olá, Maravilhosas!' card.
Buttons must have a solid, matte, sharp look. Background #C2185B (Matte Rose) with #FFFFFF text. No border radius (rounded-none) or very minimal (rounded-sm).
Section borders should be visible (e.g., border-t border-[#2A2A2A]) to give a structured, technical, editorial feel.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all buttons, CTAs, and interactive elements for testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not center align text by default; maintain strict left-alignment for body descriptions to enhance readability. Avoid generic SaaS 'glassmorphism' everywhere—prefer solid dark matte surfaces. Use generous padding (e.g., py-24). Implement elegant hover micro-interactions. If using Shadcn components, heavily customize them to remove default Vercel-like borders and shadows, replacing them with sharp, flat, dark aesthetic styling. Ensure sonner is used for any needed toasts.
